questions.questionText: On-page SEO is the process of:
options: Optimizing individual web pages with quality content and wise use of HTML source code
questions.correctAnswer: Optimizing individual web pages with quality content and wise use of HTML source code
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Optimizing individual web pages with quality content and wise use of HTML source code.

questions.questionText: Why must a website be updated as per the latest search engine guidelines?
options: Search engines keep updating their algorithms
questions.correctAnswer: Search engines keep updating their algorithms
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Search engines keep updating their algorithms.

questions.questionText: Which tag is the first thing visitors see in search results?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Title.

questions.questionText: How many characters does a title usually include at maximum before truncation?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) 60.

questions.questionText: The meta description is placed in:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) The head section.

questions.questionText: A meta description should ideally be kept within how many characters?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) 155.

questions.questionText: H1 is usually used for:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) The title of the page.

questions.questionText: Heading tags should follow the hierarchy:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) H1 to H6.

questions.questionText: What font size is recommended for readable content, especially on mobile?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) 16-point.

questions.questionText: Which content formatting guideline improves readability?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Short paragraphs.

questions.questionText: What is the purpose of anchor links in content?
options: Users immediately reach the section they want
questions.correctAnswer: Users immediately reach the section they want
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Users immediately reach the section they want.

questions.questionText: Bullet points help users to:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Scan information.

questions.questionText: URL optimization includes which three aspects?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) URL naming, structure and length.

questions.questionText: URL naming should:
options: Make clear what the page is about with keywords
questions.correctAnswer: Make clear what the page is about with keywords
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Make clear what the page is about with keywords.

questions.questionText: A short URL is recommended because:
options: It is easy to copy, paste and share
questions.correctAnswer: It is easy to copy, paste and share
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) It is easy to copy, paste and share.

questions.questionText: Internal links help:
options: Crawlers find all pages in the site
questions.correctAnswer: Crawlers find all pages in the site
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Crawlers find all pages in the site.

questions.questionText: External links to one's site:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Create credibility of the content.

questions.questionText: Page experience signals include:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Core Web Vitals.

questions.questionText: Core Web Vitals measure:
options: Loading speed, responsiveness and visual stability
questions.correctAnswer: Loading speed, responsiveness and visual stability
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Loading speed, responsiveness and visual stability.

questions.questionText: A page complies with Core Web Vitals if it meets targets at which percentile?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) 75th.

questions.questionText: A delay of how many milliseconds or less is considered good interactivity?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) 100.

questions.questionText: A layout shift score of what or less is considered good?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) 0.1.

questions.questionText:
What percentage of US citizens search for local information on smartphones, according to the
 guide?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) 94%.

questions.questionText: Which Search Console tool checks if a page is mobile-friendly?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Mobile-Friendly Test tool.

questions.questionText: HTTPS provides:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Encryption, data integrity and authentication.

questions.questionText: Encryption in HTTPS ensures:
options: An outsider cannot track the user's activities or steal information
questions.correctAnswer: An outsider cannot track the user's activities or steal information
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) An outsider cannot track the user's activities or steal information.

questions.questionText: Data integrity in HTTPS:
options: Protects data from being modified or corrupted without detection
questions.correctAnswer: Protects data from being modified or corrupted without detection
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Protects data from being modified or corrupted without detection.

questions.questionText: Authentication in HTTPS ensures:
options: Users communicate with the intended site
questions.correctAnswer: Users communicate with the intended site
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Users communicate with the intended site.

questions.questionText: Which key size is recommended for a robust security certificate?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) 2048-bit.

questions.questionText: A content audit is the process of:
options: Determining how well the website is performing
questions.correctAnswer: Determining how well the website is performing
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Determining how well the website is performing.

questions.questionText: How often should a content audit be done, according to the guide?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Once in every four months.

questions.questionText: Which tool provides in-depth analysis of website performance and answers data questions?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Google Analytics.

questions.questionText: Sitemaps are usually required when a website:
options: Is very large and has rich media content
questions.correctAnswer: Is very large and has rich media content
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Is very large and has rich media content.

questions.questionText: Does a sitemap guarantee that search engines will crawl and index pages?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) No, it only improves crawling.

questions.questionText: Which sitemap format is a text file with one URL per line?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Text format.

questions.questionText: RSS stands for:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Really Simple Syndication.

questions.questionText: Which sitemap format gives Google details about video content?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Media RSS (mRSS).

questions.questionText: HTML sitemaps are designed for:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Visitors, to navigate pages.

questions.questionText: Where is an HTML sitemap usually found?
options: At the footer of a website
questions.correctAnswer: At the footer of a website
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) At the footer of a website.

questions.questionText: How can a sitemap be submitted to Google?
options: By adding it to robots.txt or submitting it in Search Console
questions.correctAnswer: By adding it to robots.txt or submitting it in Search Console
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) By adding it to robots.txt or submitting it in Search Console.

questions.questionText: Allowing comments on blog posts can help with:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Latent Semantic Indexing (LSI) of keywords.

questions.questionText: Search intent is also known as:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) User intent.

questions.questionText: Which is the first step in thorough keyword research?
options: Ensure good knowledge about the industry
questions.correctAnswer: Ensure good knowledge about the industry
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Ensure good knowledge about the industry.

questions.questionText: Where can "Related searches" be viewed to consider more keywords?
options: At the bottom of the Google search result page
In the footer of the site
questions.correctAnswer: At the bottom of the Google search result page
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) At the bottom of the Google search result page.

questions.questionText: Which are keyword research tools mentioned?
options: Google Keyword Planner, Ahrefs and SEMrush
questions.correctAnswer: Google Keyword Planner, Ahrefs and SEMrush
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Google Keyword Planner, Ahrefs and SEMrush.

questions.questionText: CTR is calculated as:
options: Clicks received divided by the number of times the page is shown
questions.correctAnswer: Clicks received divided by the number of times the page is shown
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Clicks received divided by the number of times the page is shown.

questions.questionText: Breadcrumbs are:
options: Links that let users track where they are on a website
questions.correctAnswer: Links that let users track where they are on a website
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Links that let users track where they are on a website.

questions.questionText: Which of the following helps in structuring a site?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Breadcrumbs, tags and internal links.

questions.questionText: A contextual link is:
options: Clickable text within a web page
questions.correctAnswer: Clickable text within a web page
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Clickable text within a web page.

questions.questionText: A robots.txt file resides:
options: At the root of the site
questions.correctAnswer: At the root of the site
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) At the root of the site.

questions.questionText: How many robots.txt files can a site have?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Only one.

questions.questionText: Robots.txt rules are:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Case-sensitive.

questions.questionText: In robots.txt, "Disallow" is used to:
options: Specify a directory or page the user agent should not crawl
questions.correctAnswer: Specify a directory or page the user agent should not crawl
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Specify a directory or page the user agent should not crawl.

questions.questionText: In robots.txt, "Allow" is used to:
options: Specify a page or directory the user agent may crawl and overrides Disallow
questions.correctAnswer: Specify a page or directory the user agent may crawl and overrides Disallow
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Specify a page or directory the user agent may crawl and overrides Disallow.

questions.questionText: In robots.txt, the asterisk (*) indicates:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) All crawlers.

questions.questionText: Which tool in Search Console tests robots.txt?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) robots.txt Tester.

questions.questionText: Which encoding should the robots.txt file be saved in?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) UTF-8.

questions.questionText:
To keep a page out of search engines, which is recommended instead of relying only on
 robots.txt?
options: Block indexing or password-protect the page
questions.correctAnswer: Block indexing or password-protect the page
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Block indexing or password-protect the page.
